reviewed_by: Claude review of the Context tab declutter
reason: The operator asked to remove everything in the conversation-details Context tab below Working context except subagents: Workspace controls (checkpoint files, Save checkpoint, Schedule hourly), Operator context, Recorded prior-turn context and Technical session details. SessionsPage stops rendering them and drops the 'Save as decision' message action that seeded Operator context; ChatDecisions, ChatRecordedContext and ProviderSessionAdvanced are deleted with their unit tests. Goal children (Start child / Delegated children) are kept as ProviderGoalChildren, which renders only while a running goal may delegate or has delegated children. The operator-context and workspace-checkpoints guides are removed with their targets, and the unused checkpoint and schedule client methods go. Core is unchanged: the decisions, checkpoint, schedule and context-sources APIs remain, so real-Core journeys that used the removed editor to seed operator context now write it through PUT chat/sessions/{id}/decisions/{id}. The live Core database holds no chat_decisions entities, so no active operator context becomes invisible.
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No Python or native tests: no Python or Rust changed. Frontend selects the new ProviderGoalChildren tests and the guide catalog tests whose anchor list changed; the deleted component tests go with their components. Playwright selects conversation-details (the drawer) and the assistant entries on desktop, mobile-chromium and mobile-webkit because SessionsPage changed (message actions and the drawer). The real-Core assistant entry is not selected: its edited journeys ('interactive guides reach every assistant control', 'foundation production LAN reads durable conversation') were run locally against a Core from this branch and pass; the deployed-service and live-OpenRouter journeys need external services and skip in CI.
